footprints.description: Omron B3F 6 x 6 mm through-hole tactile switch, 4 terminals, 6.5 x 4.5 mm hole grid
footprints.note: en-b3f.pdf p.4-5 'PCB Processing Dimensions (Top View)': four 1+-0.1 dia. holes (with-ground models 1+-0.05), 6.5+-0.1 x 4.5+-0.1; pad 1.7 = 1.7 x drill 1.0 (no land printed); body 6+-0.2 x 6+-0.2; terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 4 top-left, 3 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 1 bottom-right (slots 3,2,4,1); the ground-terminal models' (B3F-11xx) 5th hole (4.1 below the top row) is a ground terminal, not drawn; B3F-1110 (7.5 mm pitch) is not covered. Same drawing in B3F.pdf p.5 and A070-E1.pdf p.4-5

footprints.description: Omron B3F/B3W 12 x 12 mm through-hole tactile switch, 4 terminals, 12.5 x 5 mm hole grid
footprints.note: en-b3f.pdf p.6 'PCB Processing Dimensions (Top View)': four 1.2+-0.05 dia. holes, 12.5+-0.1 x 5+-0.1; pad 2.05 = 1.7 x 1.2 rounded; body 12+-0.2 x 12+-0.2; terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 4 top-left, 3 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 1 bottom-right (slots 3,2,4,1); the two 1.8 dia. positioning-boss holes (9 apart) and the ground-terminal models' 5th hole are not drawn. Shared by B3W-4000 series (en-b3w.pdf p.5, B3W.pdf p.6: same holes, body 12 x 12)

footprints.description: Omron B3F-6000 radial-taped 6 x 6 mm through-hole tactile switch, 2 terminals, 5 mm pitch
footprints.note: en-b3f.pdf p.7-8 'PCB Processing Dimensions (Top View)': two 1 +0.1/-0 dia. holes 5+-0.1 apart on the body centre line; drill 1.05 mid (1.0-1.1); pad 1.8 = 1.7 x 1.05 rounded; body 6+-0.3 x 6+-0.3; terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 2 left, 1 right (slots 2,1); the ground-terminal models' (B3F-61xx) third hole (5 right of centre) is a ground terminal, not drawn

footprints.description: Omron B3F-3000 side-operated (right-angle) through-hole tactile switch, 2 terminals, 4.5 mm pitch
footprints.note: en-b3f.pdf p.5 'PCB Processing Dimensions (Top View)' and side view: switch terminals 1, 2 are the two 1+-0.05 dia. holes 4.5+-0.1 apart, 2.25 behind the body front face (plunger side, bottom of the top view); body 7.3 wide x 6.25 deep, so terminals at y = 3.125 - 2.25 = 0.875; pad 1.7 = 1.7 x drill 1.0; terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 2 left, 1 right (slots 2,1) (plunger at the bottom); terminals 3, 4 (the two 1.5+-0.05 dia. frame/ground holes, 7+-0.1 apart, 2.5 behind) are not switch terminals and are not drawn; same holes for B3F-3100/3120/3150 groups

footprints.description: Omron B3FS 6 x 6 mm surface-mount tactile switch, 4 terminals
footprints.note: en-b3fs.pdf p.3 / A113-E1.pdf p.3 'PCB Pad (Top View)': pads inner 6.4 / outer 9.6 (x), inner 3.1 / outer 5.9 (y) -> pad 1.6 x 1.4, centres span 8.0, pitch 4.5; body 6 x 6.3; terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 4 top-left, 3 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 1 bottom-right (slots 3,2,4,1)

footprints.description: Omron B3FS-109x key-top-integrated 6 x 6 mm surface-mount tactile switch, 4 terminals, 7.8 mm key top
footprints.note: A113-E1.pdf p.3 (B3FS-1092P/1095P) and p.4 (B3FS-1092P-A) 'PCB Pad (Top View)': same pads as SW-TACT-B3FS (1.6 x 1.4, span 8.0, pitch 4.5); body is the integrated key top 7.8+-0.2 x 7.8+-0.2 that covers the 6 x 6.3 switch; terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 4 top-left, 3 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 1 bottom-right (slots 3,2,4,1) (also marked (1)-(4) on the top view)

footprints.description: Omron B3FS-4 12 x 12 mm surface-mount tactile switch, 4 terminals
footprints.note: en-b3fs_4.pdf p.2 / B3FS-4092P-B.pdf p.3 'PCB Pad (Example) (Top View)': pads inner 12+-0.1 / outer 16.6+-0.1 (x), inner 2.6+-0.1 / outer 7.4+-0.1 (y) -> pad 2.3 x 2.4, centres span 14.3, pitch 5.0; body 12+-0.2 x 12+-0.2; terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 4 top-left, 3 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 1 bottom-right (slots 3,2,4,1); B3FS-4092P-B's two 2 dia. boss holes (9 apart) are not drawn

footprints.description: Omron B3S sealed 6 x 6 mm surface-mount tactile switch, 4 terminals
footprints.note: B3S-Datasheet.pdf p.2 'PCB Pad (Top View)': pads inner 6.4 / outer 9.5 (x) -> width 1.55, span 7.95; pad height 1.3, pitch 4.5; body 6 x 6.6; terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 4 top-left, 3 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 1 bottom-right (slots 3,2,4,1); the ground-terminal models' (B3S-11xx) 5th pad (1.3 wide, 3.25-4.95 below centre) is not drawn

footprints.description: Omron B3SE ultra-thin sealed 6 mm surface-mount tactile switch, 4 terminals
footprints.note: en-b3se.pdf p.2 'PCB Pad (Top View)': pads inner 3 / outer 8.5 (x), inner 3 / outer 5 (y) -> pad 2.75 x 1.0, span 5.75, pitch 4.0; body 6.2 x 7; terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 4 top-left, 3 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 1 bottom-right (slots 3,2,4,1)

footprints.description: Omron B3SL middle-stroke sealed 6 mm surface-mount tactile switch, 4 terminals
footprints.note: en-b3sl.pdf p.2 'PCB Pad (Top View)': pads inner 3 / outer 8.5 (x), inner 3 / outer 5 (y) -> pad 2.75 x 1.0, span 5.75, pitch 4.0; body 6.2 x 6.5; terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 4 top-left, 3 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 1 bottom-right (slots 3,2,4,1); pads as SW-TACT-B3SE, body 0.5 shorter

footprints.description: Omron B3SN sealed 6 x 6 mm surface-mount tactile switch, 4 terminals
footprints.note: en-b3sn.pdf p.3 'PCB Pad (Top View)': pads inner 4 / outer 9.5 (x), inner 2.6 / outer 5.4 (y) -> pad 2.75 x 1.4, span 6.75, pitch 4.0; body 6 x 6; terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 4 top-left, 3 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 1 bottom-right (slots 3,2,4,1); the ground-terminal models' (B3SN-31xx) 5th pad (right side, 1.4 high, centred) is not drawn

footprints.description: Omron B3U ultra-small 3 x 2.5 mm surface-mount tactile switch, 2 terminals
footprints.note: en-b3u.pdf p.2 (top-actuated) and p.3 (side-actuated) 'PCB Pad (Top View)': pads inner 2.6+-0.1 / outer 4.2+-0.1 -> width 0.8, span 3.4; height 1.7+-0.1; pads on the body centre line; body 3 x 2.5 (side-actuated: actuator overhangs 0.7 beyond the 2.5 body, not included); terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 2 left, 1 right (slots 2,1); the ground pad 3 (B3U-11xx/31xx) and the 0.75 dia. boss hole (-B models) are not drawn

footprints.description: Omron B3W sealed 6 x 6 mm through-hole tactile switch, 4 terminals, 6.5 x 4.5 mm hole grid
footprints.note: en-b3w.pdf p.3-4 'PCB Processing Dimensions (Top View)': four 1+-0.05 dia. holes, 6.5+-0.1 x 4.5+-0.1; pad 1.7 = 1.7 x drill 1.0; body 6+-0.2 wide x 6.6+-0.2 tall; terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 4 top-left, 3 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 1 bottom-right (slots 3,2,4,1); the ground-terminal models' (B3W-11xx) 5th hole is not drawn; same in B3W.pdf p.4-5

footprints.description: Omron B3WN sealed 8 x 8 mm radial through-hole tactile switch, 2 terminals, 5 mm pitch
footprints.note: A112-E1.pdf / en-b3wn.pdf p.2 'PCB Processing Dimensions (Top View)': two 1 +0.1/-0 dia. holes 5+-0.2 apart on the body centre line; drill 1.05 mid (1.0-1.1); pad 1.8 = 1.7 x 1.05 rounded; body 8+-0.2 x 8+-0.2; terminal numbers from the 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)' figure: 2 left, 1 right (slots 2,1)

footprints.description: Omron B3AL long-stroke 6 mm surface-mount tactile switch, 2 terminals
footprints.note: B3AL Data Sheet (1).pdf p.2 'PCB Pad (Top View)': pads inner 4 / outer 8 -> width 2, span 6; height 2; on the body centre line; body 6 x 6.9; terminal numbers from the top view outline and 'Terminal Arrangement/Internal Connections (Top View)': 2 left, 1 right (slots 2,1)
